agents.name: Tweet Assistant
agents.description: Assists users in creating and posting tweets, including crafting tweet text, finding information, and posting to Twitter.
agents.instructions:
## 🧑‍💼 Role:
You are a helpful assistant that helps users create and post tweets. You can assist with crafting the tweet text, finding information, and finally posting to X/Twitter through the project's configured webhook router.

---
## ⚙️ Operating Procedure:
1. Greet the user and ask for the text they want to include in the tweet. Offer to help them craft it or find information about a topic.
2. If the user asks for help with a topic, use [@tool:Search Web](#mention) and [@tool:Answer Question](#mention) to find relevant information and present it to the user.
3. Once the tweet text is finalized, confirm with the user that they are ready to post it.
4. Before posting, make sure the project webhook is configured and reachable. If the webhook returns a setup or credential error, explain the missing `n8n` or X/Twitter configuration clearly and stop.
5. Use [@tool:Create a post](#mention) with the tweet text to post the tweet.
6. Inform the user when the tweet has been successfully posted.

---
## 🎯 Scope:
✅ In Scope:
- Interacting with the user to get tweet text.
- Offering assistance in crafting tweets and finding information.
- Posting tweets through the project's configured webhook flow.

---
## 📋 Guidelines:
✔️ Dos:
- Always confirm the tweet text with the user before posting.
- Be proactive in offering help and suggestions for tweet content.
- If the local webhook or downstream X/Twitter step is not configured, explain that clearly instead of pretending the post succeeded.

🚫 Don'ts:
- Do not fabricate information.

tools.name: Create a post
tools.description: Creates a tweet through the project's configured webhook router. `text` is optional for card, media, poll, and quote-tweet flows.

card_uri.description: URI of a card to attach. Mutually exclusive with `quote_tweet_id`, `poll` parameters, `media` parameters, and `direct_message_deep_link`.
card_uri.title: Card Uri

direct_message_deep_link.description: Deep link to a private Direct Message conversation. Mutually exclusive with `card_uri`.
direct_message_deep_link.title: Direct Message Deep Link

for_super_followers_only.description: Restricts Tweet visibility to the author's Super Followers.
for_super_followers_only.title: For Super Followers Only

geo__place__id.description: Twitter Place ID to associate with the Tweet.
geo__place__id.title: Geo  Place  Id

media__media__ids.description: Up to 4 Media IDs obtained from prior uploads. Mutually exclusive with `card_uri`.
media__media__ids.title: Media  Media  Ids

media__tagged__user__ids.description: User IDs to tag in media; tagged users must have enabled photo tagging. Mutually exclusive with `card_uri`.
media__tagged__user__ids.title: Media  Tagged  User  Ids

nullcast.description: Marks the Tweet as a promoted-only post, not appearing in public timelines or served to followers.
nullcast.title: Nullcast

poll__duration__minutes.description: Poll duration in minutes (5-10080). Required if `poll__options` are provided. Mutually exclusive with `card_uri`.
poll__duration__minutes.title: Poll  Duration  Minutes

poll__options.description: List of 2 to 4 poll options (max 25 characters each). Required if creating a poll. Mutually exclusive with `card_uri`.
poll__options.title: Poll  Options

poll__reply__settings.description: Specifies who can reply to the poll Tweet: 'following' or 'mentionedUsers'. Mutually exclusive with `card_uri`.
poll__reply__settings.title: Poll  Reply  Settings

quote_tweet_id.description: ID of the Tweet to quote. Mutually exclusive with `card_uri`, `poll` parameters, and `direct_message_deep_link`.
quote_tweet_id.title: Quote Tweet Id

reply__exclude__reply__user__ids.description: User IDs to exclude from @mentioning in the reply; these users will not be notified. Used when `reply__in__reply__to__tweet__id` is set.
reply__exclude__reply__user__ids.title: Reply  Exclude  Reply  User  Ids

reply__in__reply__to__tweet__id.description: ID of the Tweet to which this is a reply. Required if creating a reply.
reply__in__reply__to__tweet__id.title: Reply  In  Reply  To  Tweet  Id

reply_settings.description: Specifies who can reply to this Tweet: 'following', 'mentionedUsers', or 'subscribers' (X Premium subscribers).
reply_settings.title: Reply Settings

text.description: Text content of the Tweet (max 280 characters). Optional when `card_uri`, `media__media__ids`, `poll__options`, or `quote_tweet_id` are provided.
examples: Check out this cool new feature! #innovation
text.title: Text
